evaluations.rationale: The incumbent's first step is exactly the prepared wire-level reproduction; no generated vector establishes the baseline leak itself, so every repair-oriented vector lacks its causal anchor until the plaintext target is observed receiving the header. Fixture pieces are all available locally.

Distinct normalization mechanism and feasible on loopback, but it refines the repair's comparison rather than proving the leak: under the hostname-only rule a case-varied host is already unequal, so this is a better later regression edge.

Clear and cheap: shows the predicate ignores ports entirely and tests default-port normalization. Narrower than the baseline leak and it presupposes the scheme-change leak exists; strong second-round material.
Counterexample angle on host-case normalization for the repair; feasible, but its pre-patch expectation is muddled because a case-only host difference is unequal under the current rule.
Incoherent as delivered: self-announced unfinished text that conflates two hypotheses and names no single falsifiable experiment or expected result, so it is retained but ineligible this round.

Interpretable core: 307 method and body preservation plus a header-set probe as a truth-table driver, but it is a repair-validation check, not a leak baseline, and the text shows mid-generation editing.
